## Runs 6 & 7 — SdH spot checks at D = 0 (`sdh-spot-check`)

Run 6: electron side, n = +3.2×10¹², B 0 → 10 T (50 mT to 1 T, 10 mT above), sr1 50 µV, I ≈ 9.9 nA. Run 7: hole side, n = −1.2×10¹², B 10 → 0.3 T, 20 mT. Both complete, uninterrupted, leakage clean. Raw first, then onset (`sdh_onset`) + 1/B FFT (`sdh_fft`) read against F_L and the `fs_count_b0` model table.

# === Runs 6 & 7 — RAW: gain-divided R_xx(B), no background removal ===
import numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from hera.analysis import open_run, resolve_channels, current_channel

def spot_trace(rid):
    run = open_run(f"data/{rid}")
    ch = resolve_channels(run.meta, include=["sr0", "sr1"])
    cur = current_channel(ch)
    v = [c for c in ch if c is not cur][0]
    B = np.asarray(run.col("magnet_field"), float)
    I = np.abs(np.asarray(run.col(cur.col), float) / cur.gain)
    R = np.abs(np.asarray(run.col(v.col), float) / v.gain) / I
    o = np.argsort(B)
    return B[o], R[o], float(np.median(I))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))
for a, (rid, lab) in zip(ax, [(6, "run 6 — electron, n = +3.2e12"),
                              (7, "run 7 — hole, n = -1.2e12")]):
    B, R, Imed = spot_trace(rid)
    a.plot(B, R, lw=0.6)
    a.set(xlabel="B (T)", ylabel="R_xx sr1 (Ohm)", title=f"{lab}  (I = {Imed*1e9:.1f} nA)")
    print(f"run {rid}: R({B.min():.2f} T) = {R[0]:.0f} Ohm, R_max = {R.max():.0f} Ohm at {B[np.argmax(R)]:.2f} T")
fig.tight_layout()

# === Runs 6 & 7 — onset + 1/B FFT, tones vs F_L and the fs_count model ===
from hera.analysis import sdh_onset, sdh_fft, luttinger_frequency

# fs_count_b0 model table (ABAB SWMcC / ABCA continuum; semi-quantitative — trust
# topology + partition, not absolute F):
#   n = +3.2e12: ABAB pair 7.31 / 25.78 T (m* 0.027 / 0.061 me), ABCA singleton 33.1 T
#   n = -1.2e12: ABAB pair ~5.3 / 7.1 T (near-CNP semimetal), ABCA 12.4 T (m* ~1 me, LK-dead at T_e~8K)
fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(12, 4))
for a, (rid, n12) in zip(ax, [(6, 3.2), (7, -1.2)]):
    B, R, Imed = spot_trace(rid)
    FL = float(luttinger_frequency(abs(n12) * 1e16))
    on = sdh_onset(R, B, r_full_scale=50e-6 / Imed)   # sr1 sens 50 uV both runs
    print(f"--- run {rid} (n = {n12:+.1f}e12, F_L = {FL:.1f} T) ---")
    print(on.summary())
    for cut in (max(on.onset_b, 0.6), 1.5):
        f, spec = sdh_fft(R[:, None], B, b_range=(cut, B.max()))
        a.plot(f, spec[0], lw=0.8, label=f"cut {cut:.2f} T")
    a.axvline(FL, color="k", ls="--", lw=0.8, label=f"F_L = {FL:.1f} T")
    a.set(xlabel="F (T)", xlim=(0, 1.5 * FL), title=f"run {rid} — FFT in 1/B")
    a.legend(fontsize=7)
fig.tight_layout()

# Luttinger / template arithmetic on the run-6 tone set:
f1, f2, f3 = 7.1, 22.2, 29.5
print(f"\nrun 6 pair reading: f1 + f2 = {f1+f2:.1f} T vs f3 = {f3} (sum tone, d = {f3-(f1+f2):+.1f} T ~ dF)")
print(f"  global scale (f1+f2)/F_L = {(f1+f2)/33.09:.3f}; partition {f1/(f1+f2):.3f} / {f2/(f1+f2):.3f} (model ABAB 0.221 / 0.779)")
print(f"harmonic-comb rival: 3*f1 = {3*f1:.1f} vs 22.2 (d = {22.2-3*f1:+.1f} = 2.9*dF); 4*f1 = {4*f1:.1f} vs 29.5 (d = {29.5-4*f1:+.1f})")
print(f"run 7 pair reading: 4.7 + 6.6 = {4.7+6.6:.1f} T vs F_L 12.4 -> scale {11.3/12.41:.3f} (electron side gave 0.885)")

**Read (runs 6 & 7):** the **electron side is decisively cleaner** — the fan goes there.

- **Run 6** (n = +3.2×10¹², F_L = 33.1 T): tone set {7.1, 14.1, 22.2, 29.5} T + a low cluster {3.0, 4.2, 5.2} T. Two rival readings: **(a) ABAB pair + breakdown sum** — light 7.1 / heavy 22.2, partition 0.242/0.758 (model ABAB 0.221/0.779), sum 29.3 ≈ 29.5 (Δ < δF) landing at 0.885·F_L, i.e. a single global lever-arm rescale of 0.885 (inside the 0.8–1.2 geometry prior), with 14.1 = 2×7.1 a plain harmonic; **(b) single 7.1 T pocket + harmonic comb** — but 3×7.1 = 21.3 misses 22.2 by 2.9·δF and 4×7.1 = 28.4 misses 29.5 by 1.1 T, while reading (a) closes exactly. The set is *inconsistent with ABCA* at scale 1 (no tone near 33.1 carrying full density; 7.1 alone carries only 0.21·F_L). **Lean: ABAB, pending the decisive tests** — a harmonic tracks k·f₁(n) exactly across density while a real heavy pocket follows its own Onsager curve, and the sum tone should strengthen with B relative to the fundamentals (B-window split). Both are the fan's job. Low cluster {3.0–5.2 T} carries `near-residual` flags — background-residual candidates, to be re-checked on the low-field extension's long 1/B record.
- **Run 7** (n = −1.2×10¹², F_L = 12.4 T): busy near-CNP semimetal set, as the model predicts at this |n| — a close pair 4.7/6.6 summing to 11.3 = 0.911·F_L (consistent with the electron side's 0.885 scale), plus strong unassigned 8.5/12.3 T content. Uninformative for the call beyond consistency; no fan here.
- **Onset is censored, not measured**: run 6's carrying tone (7.1 T) is above threshold at the record's low edge, and below ~0.85 T the 50 mT coarse leg undersamples it (< 2 samples/period) — `onset_b = 0.30 T` is a lower bound only. Per `sdh-spot-check`/`landau-fan`, a censored carrying tone gets a **cheap low-field extension before the fan commits**: B_lo is the fan's most expensive lever (N_rows ∝ 1/B_lo), onset 0.7 vs 1.0 T is ≈ 9 h vs ≈ 6.5 h of fan. Next: ~15 min uniform-1/B extension 0.25 → 1 T at the electron spot, then the fan with the measured B_lo.

## HERA — onset extension at the electron spot (`sdh-spot-check`), B 0.25 → 1 T, before the fan

> **05:28** · sdh-spot-check onset extension: electron spot n=+3.2e12 D=0 (Vtg,Vbg)=(+0.984,+1.166); B 0.25->1.0 T uniform-1/B 128 pts; sr1 20 uV; ends 1 T · **ETA ~05:48** (≈20 min)

Runs 6/7 read (ana): electron side decisively cleaner — tone set {7.1, 22.2, 29.5(=sum)} T reading as an ABAB pair + breakdown sum at global scale 0.885, vs a rival harmonic-comb reading the fan's n-dependence will decide. But run 6's carrying tone is **censored at the record's low edge** (`onset_b = 0.30 T` is a bound, not a measurement — the 50 mT coarse leg undersamples 7.1 T below ~0.85 T). Per `sdh-spot-check`/`landau-fan`: a censored onset gets a cheap low-field extension before a long fan commits, because B_lo is the fan's most expensive lever (onset 0.7 vs 1.0 T ⇒ ≈ 9 h vs ≈ 6.5 h of fan). This run: same spot as run 6, uniform-1/B 0.25 → 1 T (128 pts, Nyquist on 2×light = 14.2 T; higher harmonics onset above 1.3 T), sr1 at 20 µV (run 6 measured R ≤ 70 Ω here; 28× headroom, finer ADC for the weak tones). Doubles as the grid-change reproduction check on the {3.0–5.2 T} low cluster (long 1/B record, δF ≈ 0.33 T). Ends at 1 T with gates at the spot — the fan starts where this leaves the magnet.

# === SdH onset extension, electron spot (`sdh-spot-check`): n = +3.2e12 at D = 0, B 0.25 -> 1.0 T uniform-1/B ===
# Run 6's carrying tone (7.1 T) is censored at the record's low edge and the 50 mT coarse leg
# undersamples it below ~0.85 T — this pins the true onset (the fan's B_lo) before the fan commits.
from sharpelab_nb.gates import calc_gate_voltages, calc_nD

# --- session calibration from run 5 (cnp-and-dline-calibration; ratio data-calibrated, scale = geometry prior) ---
CAL = dict(c_tg=2.796e-03, c_bg=2.161e-03, n_offset=-0.0894, D_offset=-0.013)
n_spot, D_spot = 3.2, 0.0                       # 1e12 cm^-2, V/nm — same spot as run 6
Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot = calc_gate_voltages(n_spot, D_spot, CAL["c_tg"], CAL["c_bg"], CAL["n_offset"], CAL["D_offset"])
assert TG_MIN <= Vtg_spot <= TG_MAX and BG_MIN <= Vbg_spot <= BG_MAX, (Vtg_spot, Vbg_spot)
print(f"spot: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm -> (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}) V")

# --- preconditions (assumed, not set) ---
assert_thermometry_live("T_sample", VTI.temp_logfile_candidates["T_sample"], max_age=15, max_period=12)
_T0, _B0 = T_sample(), magnet.field()
print(f"precondition T_sample = {_T0:.3f} K (1.0-1.5), B = {_B0:+.4f} T (|B|<0.05: handoff left 0 T), V_si = {k_si():+.3f} V (0), "
      f"PS heater {magnet.persistent_switch_on()}, output {magnet.output_enabled()}")
assert 1.0 <= _T0 <= 1.5 and abs(_B0) < 0.05 and abs(k_si()) < 0.01
assert magnet.persistent_switch_on() and magnet.output_enabled()
# lock-in settling record (design assumes tau = 0.3 s / 24 dB; delay=0 -> 3 s driver settle = 10 tau)
_tau, _slope = sr1.time_constant(), sr1.filter_slope()
print(f"sr1 tau = {_tau} s, slope = {_slope} dB/oct")
assert abs(_tau - 0.3) < 1e-3 and _slope == 24, (_tau, _slope)

# --- field grid: uniform in 1/B, 0.25 -> 1.0 T ascending (magnet at 0; ends at 1 T where the fan picks up).
# Nyquist on the fastest tone alive below ~1.3 T (2x light = 14.2 T; 3x/4x harmonics onset above 1.3 T):
# d(1/B) = 1/(3*14.2) = 0.0235 -> N = (4 - 1)/0.0235 = 128.
B_vec = 1.0 / np.linspace(1.0 / 0.25, 1.0 / 1.0, 128)
assert B_vec.max() <= B_SESSION_CAP
I_TRIP = 1e-9
# Sensitivity 20 uV = 2 kOhm FS at ~9.9 nA: run 6 measured R <= 70 Ohm over 0-1 T at this exact spot
# (28x headroom), and the finer scale sharpens the ADC on the weak low-B oscillations.
sr1.sensitivity(20e-6)
print(f"B grid: {len(B_vec)} pts uniform-1/B, {B_vec[0]:.4f} -> {B_vec[-1]:.4f} T; sr1 sens {sr1.sensitivity()} V (settle_s {magnet.settle_s} s = dwell)")

mc = dict(meas_config); mc["Si (V)"] = k_si(); mc["sample_temperature:"] = _T0
mc["comments"] = (f"sdh-spot-check onset extension electron: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm (run-5 cal), "
                  f"(Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}), B 0.25 -> 1.0 T uniform-1/B 128 pts, sr1 20 uV")
s = sweep.AsyncStation(mc)
s.add_comment('sdh-spot-check')
s.add_comment(f'onset extension, electron side: n = {n_spot:+.2f}e12 cm^-2, D = {D_spot:+.2f} V/nm; (Vtg, Vbg) = ({Vtg_spot:+.4f}, {Vbg_spot:+.4f}); '
              f'B 0.25 -> 1.0 T uniform-1/B (run 6 onset censored at edge); cal run 5: ratio {CAL["c_bg"]/CAL["c_tg"]:.3f}, n_offset {CAL["n_offset"]:+.3f}e12, D_offset {CAL["D_offset"]:+.3f}')
s.ramp(k_bg.volt, Vbg_spot); s.ramp(k_tg.volt, Vtg_spot)
interruptible_sleep(10)

# row layout: [time, B, T_sample, k_tg.curr, k_bg.curr, sr0.X, sr0.P, sr1.X, sr1.P]
s.fp(T_sample).fp(k_tg.curr).fp(k_bg.curr)
s.fp(sr0.X).fp(sr0.P).fp(sr1.X).fp(sr1.P)
s.plot(magnet.field, sr1.X); s.plot(magnet.field, sr0.X); s.plot('time', k_tg.curr); s.plot('time', k_bg.curr)

def leak_guard(station, data):
    i_tg, i_bg = abs(float(data[3])), abs(float(data[4]))
    if i_tg > I_TRIP or i_bg > I_TRIP:
        print(f"LEAK TRIP at B={float(data[1]):+.3f} T: |I_tg|={i_tg:.3e}, |I_bg|={i_bg:.3e} A")
        station.interrupt_requested = True
s.register_run_after(leak_guard, ())

s.sweep(magnet.field, B_vec, delay=0)
# gates stay at the spot; field ends at 1.0 T — the fan starts from here (rides down to its measured B_lo).
print(f"done: B = {magnet.field():+.3f} T, (Vtg, Vbg) = ({k_tg.volt():+.4f}, {k_bg.volt():+.4f})")
